description: Ask the agent to revise a completed job. Each job includes 2 revisions; a failed revision doesn't use one. Returns the revised text, which becomes the job's result. The same as POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/revisions.

api_key.description: Your HorseToga API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

note.description: What to change, in at least 5 characters.

name: request_revision
title: Request a revision
